# Arcadium Lithium Pauses Expansion Plans on Prices, Supply Glut

- Projects in Argentina and Canada suspended or delayed
- CEO sees long-term market growth, but slower than expected

By Yvonne Yue Li

August 6, 2024 at 9:21 PM UTC

Arcadium Lithium Plc will suspend or delay two of its four expansion projects as the global market for the battery metal faces a supply glut and prolonged price slump.

The lithium producer plans to pause investment in its Galaxy project in Canada and is exploring the possibility of bringing in a partner for the project, Arcadium said in its second-quarter earnings release on Tuesday.
